GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Inclined to lay in under pressure down the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to 2 Lengths joint Lead on fence settling down, Headed exiting first turn, held together much same to turn then shifted out 1 length Two Wide Under Whip , kept trying but couldn't go with the winner in Straight and beaten out of 2nd place ovver the final 50m or so. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early/middle stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 6l off 3 wide, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # poor

Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (10L from lead). Stayed well back on inside midrace & chasing on inside @ 600m. Pushed along 3 Wide @ 450m & pressured 3 Wide (9L from lead) on home turn. No improvement in straight. # Always rearward.
Jumped Fair drifted back to last 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no run on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that he rode his mount along during the early stages to muster speed. Approaching the 800m, he elected to restrain when unable to hold a position to the inside of another runner. The gelding then raced fiercely and did not respond to his efforts to settle. Approaching the turn near the 700m, was further checked when the running to the inside of another runner tightened. Stewards found that the gelding’s racing manners were the primary cause of the incident.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back near last 4-5l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early  stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . held rail 5th, 3 Lengths @ 750m. Just couldn't quicken along rail in Straight # couldn't quicken
Jumped Fast . Took a trail 4th the fence 4 Lengths @ 800m. Under Whip into Straight . Just Held Ground # Just an Even Effort
Jumped Ok , got back 2nd last rails 7 Lengths 600m, still long way off them getting to Middle Of Track at 200m, charged late but from too far back # hit line hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages. Near the 200m was steadied and directed out across heels to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , tailed off last 20 Lengths 600m, non competitive and beaten a big space, lugging bit first time # non-competitive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, got its head up and refused to settle and raced ungenerously throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding which was beaten 19L revealed no abnormalities. Trainer was advised that the gelding would be required to perform to the Steward’s satisfaction in an official barrier trial prior to being permitted to start in a race again. Passed trial.
